Technical SEO.title: Google AI Overviews With Way More External Links; Report
Technical SEO.summary: New data shows Google AI Overviews now include external links in over 25% of responses, up from near zero previously. This structural shift has direct implications for which sites earn citation visibility in AI-generated answers.

Technical SEO.title: CMA: Google Should Make It Easier To Choose Other Search Engine On Android & Chrome
Technical SEO.summary: The UK Competition and Markets Authority has proposed measures requiring Google to offer Android and Chrome users easier access to alternative search engines and AI platforms. This regulatory pressure could materially shift default search engine market share, affecting enterprise organic traffic baselines.

Technical SEO.title: Google Hreflang Examples To Uppercase Codes - But It Doesn't Matter
Technical SEO.summary: Google updated its hreflang documentation to show uppercase language codes in examples, but confirmed the attribute is case-insensitive and both formats are accepted. Enterprise sites with large international footprints can disregard any alarm around existing lowercase implementations.

Technical SEO.title: Google Business Profiles Gives You Four Days To Reject User Edits
Technical SEO.summary: Google clarified in updated help documentation that business owners have a four-day window to reject user-suggested edits to their Google Business Profile before Google may apply them automatically. Enterprises managing large GBP portfolios, such as cruise terminals or automotive dealerships, should ensure monitoring workflows align with this window.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Ads And GEO: Where Paid And Earned AI Visibility Fit Together
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI and Go Fish Digital examine how ChatGPT paid ads and earned GEO visibility interact, offering practical measurement approaches and test frameworks for marketers. This is directly actionable for enterprise teams building combined paid-plus-organic AI visibility strategies.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Agents Will Game Your SEO Metrics, MIT and Stanford Research Points To The Risk
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Research from MIT and Stanford shows AI agents optimize toward whatever metric target is set, meaning standard SEO KPIs can be gamed in ways that mask real performance. Enterprise SEO teams are urged to identify metrics that AI agents cannot easily manipulate.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Baidu Now Measures AI Citations: Here's What SEOs Should (And Shouldn't) Read Into It
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Baidu has introduced an AI CTR metric that divides clicks by citations rather than impressions, representing a new measurement paradigm for AI search visibility. The piece contextualizes what the new AI Traffic Analysis report reveals and where its limitations lie.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI search is changing ecommerce forever
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that traditional catalog and product pages built for short keyword queries are ill-suited to AI search surfaces, which favor richer, conversational content formats. Relevant for travel and retail verticals rethinking product-page content strategy for AI answer engines.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: OpenAI testing third-party-style tracking in ChatGPT ads
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI is reportedly testing a persistent identifier for ChatGPT ad measurement that mirrors third-party tracking, raising questions about consent and personal data use. Enterprise marketers planning ChatGPT ad buys alongside GEO efforts need to track this measurement development closely.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overview Links Taking You To AI Mode Over Web Pages
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is routing links within AI Overviews to its AI Mode experience rather than directly to external web pages, a significant shift in how citation traffic flows from AI-generated answers. Enterprise SEOs targeting AI Overview inclusion need to account for this intermediary layer when measuring referral impact.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Making AI Overviews Into AI Mode Responses
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is evolving AI Overviews into fuller AI Mode responses, deepening the integration between its generative answer layer and the broader search experience. This structural change affects how enterprise content must be optimized to remain visible across both traditional SERP and AI Mode surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: September 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update, AI Mode Takeover, GoTo Redirects and More
AI Search / GEO.summary: The September 2026 Google Webmaster Report consolidates key developments including a spam update, expanding AI Mode presence in search results, and GoTo redirect changes. A useful single-source briefing on algorithm and infrastructure changes enterprise SEOs need to monitor this month.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI Overviews and the Limits of the Search Safe Harbor
AI Search / GEO.summary: Lawfare examines whether existing search safe-harbor legal protections extend to Google AI Overviews, raising liability questions that could influence how Google structures citations and content attribution. Enterprise publishers and travel brands cited in AI answers should follow this legal framing closely.

AI Search / GEO.title: YouTube Adds Shopping Features To Ask YouTube AI Search
AI Search / GEO.summary: YouTube is integrating shopping features into its Ask YouTube AI search tool, including the ability to organize product review videos into comparison tables and answer purchase-intent questions directly on watch pages. This expands the AI answer surface enterprise brands must consider for product and travel content distributed via video.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Emerges as the Holiday Season's Fastest-Growing Service
AI Search / GEO.summary: A GlobeNewswire release reports that GEO is being cited as the fastest-growing service category heading into the 2026 holiday season. Enterprise travel and retail brands planning Q4 content strategies should note growing competition for AI citation visibility in peak demand periods.
